question_en: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six members in a family in which there are two married couples. T a teacher is married to a doctor who is mother of R and U. Q the lawyer is married to P has one son and one grand son. Of the two married ladies one is a housewife. There is also one student and one male engineer in the family. Who among the following is the housewife?
question_ta: P, Q, R, S, T மற்றும் U ஆகியோர் ஒரு குடும்பத்தின் 6 உறுப்பினர்கள். அவர்களில் இரண்டு திருமணமான தம்பதியர் உள்ளனர். T என்பவர் ஒரு ஆசிரியர் ஒரு மருத்துவரான ஆர் மற்றும் யூ-ன் தாயாரான மருத்துவரை மணந்து கொண்டுள்ளார். Q என்பவர் ஒரு சட்ட வல்லுநர், மேலும் அவர் P ஐ மணந்து கொண்டுள்ளார். P என்பவருக்கு ஒரு மகன் மற்றும் ஒரு பேரன் உள்ளனர். இரு திருமணமான பெண்களில் ஒருவர் வீட்டில் இருப்பவர் மற்றும் அந்த குடும்பத்தில் ஒரு பொறியாளர் மற்றும் ஒரு மாணவர் உள்ளனர். எனில் கீழ்க்கண்டவர்களில் யார் வீட்டில் இருக்கும் பெண்?
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
Since T is a teacher and married to the doctor, the doctor is female. Q the lawyer is married to P. The doctor is not a housewife (as she is a doctor). The question states that out of two married ladies, one is a housewife. Since the doctor is not, P (married to Q) must be the housewife.

question_en: A does 20% less work than B. If A can complete a piece of work in $7\frac{1}{2}$ hours then B can do it in
question_ta: A என்பவர் B என்பவரை விட 20% குறைவாக வேலை பார்க்கிறார். ஒரு வேலையை A $7\frac{1}{2}$ மணி நேரத்தில் முடிப்பாரானால் B எவ்வளவு நேரம் எடுப்பார்?
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Let B's efficiency be 5, then A's efficiency is 4 (20% less).
  - Time taken by A = $7.5$ hours.
  - Total Work = Efficiency $\times$ Time = $4 \times 7.5 = 30$ units.
  - Time taken by B = $30 / 5 = 6$ hours.

question_en: If 4 men can complete a work in 3 days and 3 women can complete that work in 6 days, then which one of the following is not true?
question_ta: ஒரு வேலையை 4 ஆண்கள் 3 நாட்களில் முடிப்பர் மற்றும் அதே வேலையை 3 பெண்கள் 6 நாட்களில் முடிப்பர் எனில் பின்வருவனவற்றுள் தவறானது எது?

A.en: 8 men and 6 women can complete the work in one day
A.ta: 8 ஆண்கள் மற்றும் 6 பெண்கள் ஒரே நாளில் வேலையை முடிப்பர்

B.en: 6 men and 8 women can complete the work in one day
B.ta: 6 ஆண்கள் மற்றும் 8 பெண்கள் ஒரே நாளில் வேலையை முடிப்பர்

C.en: 12 men can complete the work in one day
C.ta: 12 ஆண்கள் அந்த வேலையை ஒரே நாளில் முடிப்பர்

D.en: 18 women can complete the work in one day
D.ta: 18 பெண்கள் அந்த வேலையை ஒரே நாளில் முடிப்பர்

subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- 4 Men in 3 days $\implies$ 1 Man rate = $1 / (4 \times 3) = 1/12$.
  - 3 Women in 6 days $\implies$ 1 Woman rate = $1 / (3 \times 6) = 1/18$.
  - Let's check (B): 6 Men and 8 Women rate = $6(1/12) + 8(1/18) = 1/2 + 4/9 = 17/18 \neq 1$ work in one day. So statement (B) is not true.

question_en: The area of circle increased by 66 sq.cm. If its radius is increased by 1 cm. Find the area of new circle.
question_ta: வட்டத்தின் ஆரம் 1 செ.மீ அதிகரிக்கும் போது வட்டத்தின் பரப்பு 66 சதுர செ.மீ. அதிகரிக்கிறது. புதிய வட்டத்தின் பரப்பு காண்க.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- $\pi(r+1)^2 - \pi r^2 = 66 \implies \pi(2r+1) = 66 \implies 2r+1 = 66 \times \frac{7}{22} = 21 \implies r = 10$ cm.
  - New radius = $11$ cm.
  - Area of new circle = $\pi \times 11^2 = \frac{22}{7} \times 121 = \frac{2 \times 11 \times 11^2}{7} = \frac{2}{7} \times 11^3$ sq.cm.

question_en: The population of a town is increasing at the rate of 6% per annum. It was 238765 in the year 2018. Find the population of the year 2020.
question_ta: ஒரு நகரத்தில் மக்கள் தொகை ஆண்டுக்கு 6% அதிகரிக்கிறது. 2018 ஆம் ஆண்டு மக்கள் தொகை 238765 ஆக இருந்தது. 2020ஆம் ஆண்டின் மக்கள் தொகையைக் காண்க.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Initial population ($P$) in 2018 = 238,765.
  - Rate of increase ($R$) = 6% per annum.
  - Time period ($n$) = 2 years (from 2018 to 2020).
  - Population in 2020 = $P \times (1 + \frac{R}{100})^n = 238,765 \times (1.06)^2 = 238,765 \times 1.1236 \approx 268,276$.

question_en: If the Simple Interest on Rs. 20,000 be more than the Simple Interest on Rs. 15,000 by Rs. 3,000 in 5 years, the rate percent p.a. is?
question_ta: 5 ஆண்டுகளில் அசல் ரூ. 20,000 மேல் கிடைக்கும் தனி வட்டியானது அசல் ரூ. 15,000 மேல் கிடைக்கும் தனி வட்டியை விட ரூ. 3,000 அதிகம் எனில் ஆண்டு வட்டி வீதம் காண்க.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Difference in Simple Interest ($\text{SI}_1 - \text{SI}_2$) = Rs. 3,000.
  - Difference in Principal ($P_1 - P_2$) = $20,000 - 15,000 = 5,000$.
  - Time ($T$) = 5 years.
  - Formula: $\text{SI}_{\text{diff}} = \frac{P_{\text{diff}} \times R \times T}{100} \implies 3,000 = \frac{5,000 \times R \times 5}{100} = 250 \times R \implies R = \frac{3,000}{250} = 12\%$.

question_en:
If $\frac{6x+2y}{3x+4y} = \frac{3}{4}$ and $\frac{x+z}{2x+3z} = \frac{3}{7}$
  Then find $x : y : z$.
question_ta:
$\frac{6x+2y}{3x+4y} = \frac{3}{4}$ மற்றும் $\frac{x+z}{2x+3z} = \frac{3}{7}$
  எனில் $x : y : z$ ஐ காண்க.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- From $\frac{6x+2y}{3x+4y} = \frac{3}{4} \implies 24x + 8y = 9x + 12y \implies 15x = 4y \implies x : y = 4 : 15$.
  - From $\frac{x+z}{2x+3z} = \frac{3}{7} \implies 7x + 7z = 6x + 9z \implies x = 2z \implies x : z = 2 : 1 = 4 : 2$.
  - Combining these ratios: $x : y : z = 4 : 15 : 2$.

question_en: The LCM of three different numbers is 120. Which of the following cannot be their HCF?
question_ta: மூன்று எண்களின் மீ.சி.ம. ஆனது 120 எனில் கொடுக்கப்பட்ட எண்ணில் எது மீ.பொ.வ. ஆக இருக்க இயலாது?
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
The Highest Common Factor (HCF) of any set of numbers must always be a factor/divisor of their Least Common Multiple (LCM). Here, the LCM is 120. Divisors of 120 include 8, 12, and 24. Since 35 is not a divisor of 120, it cannot be their HCF.

question_en: During one year, the population of a town increased by 5% and during the next year, the population decreased by 5%. If the total population is 9,975 at the end of the second year, then what was the population size in the beginning of the first year?
question_ta: ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட வருடத்தில் ஒரு நகரத்தின் மக்கள் தொகை 5% அதிகரிக்கிறது. மேலும் அதற்கு அடுத்த வருடத்தில் மக்கள் தொகை 5% குறைகிறது. இரண்டாவது ஆண்டின் முடிவில் மொத்த மக்கள் தொகை 9,975 எனில் முதலாம் ஆண்டின் தொடக்கத்தில் மக்கள் தொகை எவ்வளவு?
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Let the initial population be $x$.
  - Year 1 (+5%): $1.05x$.
  - Year 2 (-5%): $1.05x \times 0.95 = 0.9975x$.
  - Given $0.9975x = 9,975 \implies x = \frac{9,975}{0.9975} = 10,000$.

question_en: What fraction should be added to the sum of $5\frac{3}{4}$, $4\frac{4}{5}$ and $7\frac{3}{8}$ to make the result a whole number?
question_ta: $5\frac{3}{4}$, $4\frac{4}{5}$ மற்றும் $7\frac{3}{8}$ இவற்றின் கூடுதலுடன் எந்த பின்னத்தைக் கூட்ட அது ஒரு முழு எண்ணாகும்?
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- The sum of fractional parts of $5\frac{3}{4}$, $4\frac{4}{5}$, and $7\frac{3}{8}$ is: $\frac{3}{4} + \frac{4}{5} + \frac{3}{8}$.
  - Taking LCM of 4, 5, 8 (which is 40): $\frac{30 + 32 + 15}{40} = \frac{77}{40} = 1\frac{37}{40}$.
  - To make the sum a whole number, we must add a fraction $f$ to the remainder $\frac{37}{40}$ such that $\frac{37}{40} + f = 1 \implies f = \frac{3}{40}$.

question_en:
In an A.P
  $t_{20} + t_{21} + t_{22} + ..... + t_{30} = 0$
  Which one of the following is false?

D.en: If $d$ is positive, $a$ is also positive

subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- The sum has 11 terms: $t_{20}$ to $t_{30}$. The sum of an AP is given by $n \times \text{middle term} = 11 \times t_{25} = 0 \implies t_{25} = 0$. Thus, (A) is true.
  - Since $t_{25} = a + 24d = 0$, we get $a = -24d$.
  - If common difference $d$ is positive ($d > 0$), then the first term $a = -24d$ must be negative. Thus, the statement "If $d$ is positive, $a$ is also positive" is false.
  - (B) is true because terms with equal intervals ($10d$ difference) always form an A.P.
  - (C) is true because $t_{n_1} + t_{n_2} = a + (n_1-1)d + a + (n_2-1)d = 2a + (n_1+n_2-2)d = 2(-24d) + (50-2)d = -48d + 48d = 0$.

question_en: In a class of 35 students Kamal is placed seventh from the bottom whereas Suresh is placed ninth from the top. Ramesh is placed exactly in between the two. What is Kamal's position from Ramesh?
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Total students = 35.
  - Suresh's position = 9th from top.
  - Kamal's position = 7th from bottom $\implies 35 - 7 + 1 = 29$th from top.
  - The number of students strictly between Suresh and Kamal is $29 - 9 - 1 = 19$ students.
  - Ramesh is exactly in the middle. The middle rank of the range [9, 29] is $\frac{9+29}{2} = 19$th rank from top.
  - Therefore, Ramesh is at rank 19. Kamal is at rank 29.
  - Kamal's position relative to Ramesh is $29 - 19 = 10$ places behind.

question_en: What is the probability of getting a prime number as a sum from two throws of a dice?
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Total possible outcomes when two dice are rolled = $6 \times 6 = 36$.
  - Possible sums range from 2 to 12. Prime sums are: 2, 3, 5, 7, and 11.
  - Count outcomes for each prime sum:
    - Sum 2: (1,1) $\rightarrow 1$ outcome
    - Sum 3: (1,2), (2,1) $\rightarrow 2$ outcomes
    - Sum 5: (1,4), (2,3), (3,2), (4,1) $\rightarrow 4$ outcomes
    - Sum 7: (1,6), (2,5), (3,4), (4,3), (5,2), (6,1) $\rightarrow 6$ outcomes
    - Sum 11: (5,6), (6,5) $\rightarrow 2$ outcomes
  - Favorable outcomes = $1 + 2 + 4 + 6 + 2 = 15$.
  - Probability = $\frac{15}{36}$.

question_en: The radius of a circle is increased so that its circumference is increased by 5%. Find the percentage of increase in its area.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Circumference $C = 2\pi r$. If $C$ increases by 5%, the radius $r$ must also increase by 5%.
  - Let initial radius be $r$. New radius $r' = 1.05r$.
  - Initial Area $A = \pi r^2$. New Area $A' = \pi (r')^2 = \pi (1.05r)^2 = 1.1025 \pi r^2 = 1.1025A$.
  - Percentage increase in area = $(1.1025 - 1) \times 100\% = 10.25\%$.
  - Alternatively, using successive percentage formula: $x + y + \frac{xy}{100} = 5 + 5 + \frac{25}{100} = 10.25\%$.

question_en: The diagonal of a cubic room is $11\sqrt{3}$ feet. Find the volume of it.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- The formula for the diagonal of a cube is $d = \sqrt{3} a$, where $a$ is the side length.
  - Given $\sqrt{3} a = 11\sqrt{3} \implies a = 11$ feet.
  - Volume of a cube $V = a^3 = 11^3 = 1331$ cubic feet.

question_en: Find the amount to be received after 2 years 6 months at the rate of 5% p.a. of Simple Interest on a sum Rs. 6,400.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Principal ($P$) = 6,400, Rate ($R$) = 5%, Time ($N$) = 2 years 6 months = $2.5$ years.
  - Simple Interest ($I$) = $\frac{P \times N \times R}{100} = \frac{6400 \times 2.5 \times 5}{100} = 64 \times 12.5 = 800$.
  - Total amount to be received ($A$) = $P + I = 6400 + 800 = 7,200$.

question_en: The maximum speed of the Elephant is 20 km/hr, the Lion is 80 km/hr and the Cheetah is 100 km/hr. Find the ratio of the speed and find which ratio is the least one.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Speeds: Elephant ($E$) = 20, Lion ($L$) = 80, Cheetah ($C$) = 100.
  - Check ratios:
    - $E : L = 20/80 = 1/4 = 0.25$.
    - $L : C = 80/100 = 4/5 = 0.80$.
    - $E : C = 20/100 = 1/5 = 0.20$.
    - $L : E = 80/20 = 4/1 = 4.00$.
  - The smallest ratio is 0.20, which is the speed ratio of the Elephant to the Cheetah.

question_en: The traffic lights at three different road crossings change after every 48 sec, 72 sec and 108 sec respectively. If they all change simultaneously at 8 : 20 : 00 hours. Then at what time will they again change simultaneously?
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- To find when they change simultaneously again, find the LCM of 48, 72, and 108.
    - $48 = 2^4 \times 3$
    - $72 = 2^3 \times 3^2$
    - $108 = 2^2 \times 3^3$
    - $\text{LCM} = 2^4 \times 3^3 = 16 \times 27 = 432$ seconds.
  - Convert 432 seconds into minutes: $\frac{432}{60} = 7 \text{ minutes } 12 \text{ seconds}$.
  - Add this to the starting time: 8 : 20 : 00 + 7 min 12 sec = 8 : 27 : 12 hours.

question_en: Find the greatest number which on dividing 1657 and 2037 leaves remainders 6 and 5 respectively.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Subtract the respective remainders:
    - $1657 - 6 = 1651$
    - $2037 - 5 = 2032$
  - Now, find the HCF of 1651 and 2032.
  - Using prime factorization or division method:
    - $2032 = 1651 \times 1 + 381$
    - $1651 = 381 \times 4 + 127$
    - $381 = 127 \times 3 + 0$
  - Thus, the HCF is 127, which is the greatest number that satisfies the condition.

question_en: The greatest number which can divide 1356, 1868 and 2764 having the same remainder 12 in each case is ____________?
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Subtract the common remainder 12 from each of the numbers:
    - $1356 - 12 = 1344$
    - $1868 - 12 = 1856$
    - $2764 - 12 = 2752$
  - Find the HCF of 1344, 1856, and 2752.
    - $1856 - 1344 = 512$
    - $2752 - 1856 = 896$
    - HCF of differences (512 and 896) is 128. Let's check divisors.
    - Since 128 does not divide 1344 ($1344 / 128 = 10.5$), check the next largest factor of 128, which is 64.
    - 64 divides 1344 ($64 \times 21$), 1856 ($64 \times 29$), and 2752 ($64 \times 43$).
  - Hence, the greatest number is 64.

question_en: A water heater is sold by a trader for Rs. 10,502 including GST at 18%. Find the GST amount.
subject: Aptitude
explanation_en:
- Selling Price (including 18% GST) = 10,502.
  - Let Cost Price (excluding GST) be $x$.
  - $1.18x = 10,502 \implies x = \frac{10502}{1.18} = 8,900$.
  - GST Amount = Selling Price - Cost Price = $10,502 - 8,900 = 1,602$.
